source.raw_extract: DTU has a very limited number of tuition fee waivers to award International new non-EU/EEA MSc students applying for the Autumn intake. [...] All non-EU/EEA students who apply by the 15 January deadline and who wish to apply for a tuition fee waiver must submit a separate personal statement with the application, clearly specifying that you are applying for the tuition fee waiver. Non-EU/EEA applicants with a qualifying degree from Denmark must apply by the 15th January to be considered for the tuition fee waiver. [...] Tuition fee waivers are granted after you have accepted an offer of admission. For more information, please visit important dates and deadlines.
source.notes: DTU's own scholarship page states the waiver deadline as 'the 15 January deadline' for the Autumn intake, and no year appears anywhere on that page or on the linked DTU important-dates page. The deadline is therefore recurring annual timing tied to the Autumn intake, not an explicit calendar deadline, so it is classified ANNUAL with precision 'recurring' and deliberately NOT converted to 2027-01-15 (brief section 6: never date an ANNUAL value; brief section 5: no cycle assumptions). This is the scholarship's own deadline wording, not a borrowed admissions deadline: the waiver page makes the 15 January deadline the waiver deadline itself. The shard's cited quote was verified verbatim on the live page. The shard's official_source_url was also fetched and does not contain this wording; the page above is the correct official location.
